title: GSK drinks in Chai Discovery’s AI models after wet-lab validation
summary: GSK has joined Chai Discovery’s growing roster of Big Pharma clients, signing up to access protein-folding and design models.

title: ‘We’re making a lot of progress’: How Nobel-winning optogenetics is being harnessed by biotechs
summary: As a notorious night owl, it was already very early in the morning of October 5 when Karl Deisseroth, M.D., Ph.D., finally laid down to get some shuteye. Not long after, the phone of the Stanford psychiatrist and bioengineer lit up with an incoming call from Sweden.

title: Chutes & Ladders—Vir looks to Liu to lead late-stage push
summary: As Vir pushes its lead hepatitis D combo through phase 3 development, the biotech has tapped an experienced medical expert to light the way. David Liu, M.D., Ph.D., is now Vir’s chief medical officer, after most recently serving in the same role at Nuvation Bio.

title: How we picked the Fierce 15
summary: What does it mean to be a Fierce 15 biotech in 2026? With this year’s list unveiled, the Fierce Biotech team gets together to discuss what the winners tell us about the state of the sector.

title: Lilly-backed TRex rakes in $117M IPO, while hypertension biotech Retension reveals $45M listing
summary: Eli Lilly-backed TRex Bio and hypertension-focused Retension Pharmaceuticals brought in $116.7 million and $45 million from their respective IPOs, continuing a bumper year for biotech listings.

title: Endeavor’s threat to IPF incumbents increases after phase 2 win for Hedgehog inhibitor
summary: Endeavor BioMedicines solidified its potential threat to Big Pharma with a phase 2b readout suggesting its Hedgehog inhibitor could become the first drug to reduce lung fibrosis while increasing total lung capacity.

title: AI biotech Iambic aims for $135M IPO to push cancer drugs through clinic
summary: Iambic Therapeutics is aiming to raise $135 million in net proceeds from an IPO as the AI biotech looks to fund the clinical development of its lead cancer drug.

title: Ono pays $80M for regional rights to trio of Biohaven IgG degraders, including phase 3 Grave’s asset
summary: Japan’s Ono Pharmaceutical is paying $80 million upfront for the regional rights to a trio of Biohaven’s IgG degraders, led by a phase 3-stage Grave’s disease prospect.

title: Zealand, Roche’s ‘intriguing’ weight loss for amylin drug soured by blood sugar data
summary: Zealand Pharma has reported more phase 2 data on its Roche-partnered amylin analog, linking the drug candidate to competitive weight loss but a lackluster effect on blood sugar.

title: Argenx digests phase 2 celiac win for $2.2B drug, preps pivotal run
summary: A phase 2 celiac disease trial of argenx’s FB102 has hit its primary endpoint, delivering a boost to a drug candidate that the biotech acquired in its $2.2 billion takeover of Forte Biosciences.

title: Cadrenal launches strategic review for late-stage cardiology pipeline
summary: Cadrenal Therapeutics, a heart-focused biotech that recently reached an agreement with the FDA on the design of a pivotal trial for its lead candidate, is now instead looking to offload its pipeline or potentially the entire company.

title: ARPA-H unveils Surpass program to accelerate and expand clinical trials
summary: The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services announced the launch of a new program aimed at removing barriers that slow clinical development and transforming how clinical trials are designed and conducted.

title: TCGX launches $600M fund to bankroll Asian biotechs
summary: Investment firm TCGX is expanding in Asia, raising $600 million to funnel into biotechs emerging from a burgeoning drug discovery hotspot.

title: Cerevance rescues its Parkinson's drug with phase 3 win
summary: Cerevance's oral non-dopaminergic therapy has redeemed itself by improving both motor and non-motor symptoms in a phase 3 Parkinson's disease study.

title: Atsena’s Lighthouse gene therapy readout illuminates eye disease efficacy
summary: Atsena Therapeutics has reported evidence of efficacy in a clinical trial of an eye disease gene therapy, encouraging the biotech to forge ahead with a study that could support a filing for approval in 2028.

title: Matchpoint nets $150M series B to take covalent med into clinic
summary: Matchpoint Therapeutics has aced its series B round, serving up $150 million to advance the Sanofi-backed biotech’s pipeline of precision covalent medicines.

title: MimiVax’s cancer vaccine fails phase 2 glioblastoma study, but CEO still sees data as ‘inspiring’
summary: MimiVax has reports a phase 2b miss in newly diagnosed glioblastoma patients, but remains positive about a significant survival benefit in a subset of patients 65 years and under.

title: CAR-T biotech Caribou makes ‘heartbreaking’ call to shrink headcount, halt pipeline
summary: The Bay Area biotech is discontinuing all clinical development activities and implementing a "substantial reduction in workforce."

title: Stryker strikes up a new CEO in Spencer Stiles as Kevin Lobo moves upstairs
summary: Stryker veteran Spencer Stiles will take up the chief executive role as its former CEO Kevin Lobo will move into the boardroom.

title: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig halts development of lead fusion protein in rare autoimmune disease
summary: Big Pharma-backed Nuvig Therapeutics has halted one of the two trials for its sole clinical asset after determining the program wouldn’t be able to advance quickly enough.

title: Abbott nabs FDA approval for new CardioMEMS HF System that allows heart readings to be seen at home
summary: Abbott has been given U.S. clearance for new updates to its CardioMEMS HF System that allow for patient-facing capabilities through its CardioGuide HF App.

title: Alzheimer’s disease target and drug discovery by leveraging multiomics and electronic health data
summary: Nature Neuroscience, Published online: 08 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41593-026-02472-0Hou et al. show a drug target compendium supported by human genetic and real-world patient data for Alzheimer’s disease and validate epoxide hydrolase 2 as a causal Alzheimer’s disease target using CRISPR interference and gene editing experiments in human models.

title: Modality-specific reactive and predictive responses in the human superior colliculus
summary: Nature Neuroscience, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41593-026-02480-0Chen et al. use 7-Tesla fMRI to show that the human superior colliculus has modality-specific, depth-dependent activity prior to visual or somatosensory events, resembling its response to actual stimulation.

title: Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport deficits in C9ORF72 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons
summary: Nature Neuroscience, Published online: 07 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41593-026-02464-0Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport in motor neurons through mitochondrial bioenergetics, a process disrupted in C9ORF72-mediated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Enhancing astrocytic mitochondrial metabolism restores transport deficits.

title: Publisher Correction: A population code for semantics in human hippocampus
summary: Nature Neuroscience, Published online: 06 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41593-026-02501-yPublisher Correction: A population code for semantics in human hippocampus

title: Human claustrum neurons encode uncertainty and prediction errors during aversive learning
summary: Nature Neuroscience, Published online: 06 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41593-026-02475-xHuman claustrum neurons track uncertainty and prediction errors during aversive learning, suggesting a role for the claustrum in updating beliefs and guiding adaptive behavior in dynamic environments.
